name: Bolton Vouched
maker: YSB Designs, a trading name of YSB Ventures Ltd
maturity: Live and open at www.boltonvouched.co.uk, with reviews, Ask Bolton, price guides and paid Pro built; the policy pages are still drafts pending legal review.

brand.tone: Warm, neighbourly and plain-spoken, written in British English and scrupulously honest about what is built, what is coming and what is never for sale.

facts.text: Bolton Vouched brings together local people, vouched for by Bolton.

source.quote: **Local people, vouched for by Bolton.**

facts.text: Bolton Vouched gathers the tradespeople that Bolton's WhatsApp group recommends in one place, alongside the checks that have been made on them.

source.quote: The tradespeople Bolton's WhatsApp group recommends, in one place, with the checks we've made.

facts.text: For Bolton residents who need a trusted tradesperson, it is free, with no account needed to look or call.

source.quote: | **Residents** | Free. No account to look or call |

facts.text: For local tradespeople, a basic listing is free for good, including the page, Call and WhatsApp buttons, reviews, the review link and QR card, the enquiry count, the Taking on work switch and the website badge.

source.quote: | **A basic listing** | Free, for good: the page, Call and WhatsApp, reviews, the review link and QR card, the enquiry count, the *Taking on work* switch and the website badge |

facts.text: Good recommendations in the local WhatsApp group scroll away under hundreds of messages, so the next person has to ask all over again.

source.quote: Then they scroll away under a few hundred messages, and the next person asks again.

facts.text: Every week someone in the Bolton Tradesmen WhatsApp group asks whether anyone knows a good tradesperson.

source.quote: Every week someone in the Bolton Tradesmen WhatsApp group asks *"anyone know a good…?"*.

facts.text: A directory of tradespeople's mobile numbers is exactly what spammers and scrapers want, and traders who get cold-called will not stay listed.

source.quote: A directory of tradespeople's mobile numbers is exactly what spammers and scrapers want

facts.text: Nobody can pay to move up the list, and that promise is the heart of the product.

source.quote: **Nobody can pay to move up the list.** That sentence is the product.

facts.text: Recommended people are kept where you can find them, sorted by trade and by the BL areas they cover, with a button to call or WhatsApp them.

source.quote: group recommends, sorted by trade and by the BL areas they cover, with what

facts.text: Payment never affects ranking: a trader's place in the list comes from reviews only.

source.quote: **Payment never affects ranking.** A trader's place in the list comes from reviews only.

facts.text: Pick a trade and an area, then call or WhatsApp a trader in one tap.

source.quote: Pick a trade and an area, then call or WhatsApp them in one tap.

facts.text: The directory covers 66 trades in eight groups, from home and trades to business and finance.

source.quote: **66 trades in eight groups**: home and trades, repairs and appliances, moving and waste,

facts.text: Profiles show what has been checked about each trader, such as ID, insurance, Gas Safe and DVSA.

source.quote: we've checked about them (ID, insurance, Gas Safe, DVSA and so on) and a button

facts.text: Gas and boiler listings cannot go live without a Gas Safe check, and driving instructors need a DVSA ADI check.

source.quote: A trader is only listed under Gas & boilers with an in-date Gas Safe check, and under Driving instructors with an in-date DVSA ADI check.

facts.text: Every trader on Bolton Vouched has agreed to be listed, after reading exactly how they will appear.

source.quote: Every trader on it has agreed to be listed.

facts.text: Residents can leave a review by signing in with Google or a code sent to their email.

source.quote: sign in with Google or a code sent to your email to leave a review.

facts.text: Reviews take one screen of taps, can be edited for 14 days and can carry an optional private proof photo or PDF.

source.quote: editable for 14 days, with an optional private proof photo or PDF (location data

facts.text: Traders linked to their listing can reply once to each review.

source.quote: Then they reply once to each review.

facts.text: Traders can show whether they are taking on work or booked up until a date, and this never changes the order or a badge.

source.quote: the date), can filter a category list, and never changes the order or a badge.

facts.text: The trader dashboard shows enquiries this month and all time.

facts.text: Ask Bolton lets signed-in residents ask the community for a good tradesperson, with answers that must name a live listing in that trade.

source.quote: Answers must name a live listing in that

facts.text: Price guides are built only from reviews, a trade at a time, once that trade has 10 counted reviews.

source.quote: only from reviews, a trade at a time, once it has 10 counted reviews

facts.text: Traders' phone numbers are never in the page's HTML, so scrapers reading the page find no phone numbers.

source.quote: Scrapers reading the page find no phone numbers.

facts.text: Looking around keeps nothing: no cookies, no account and no analytics.

source.quote: | Someone looks around | Nothing. No cookies, no account, no analytics | Nowhere |

facts.text: Pro, the optional paid tier for traders, is live.

source.quote: email sign-in and Pro are live, so say so plainly.

facts.text: Pro costs £10 a month or £100 a year through Stripe, open to any listed trader, and adds job requests, alerts, quotes and invoices, review requests, an ID check, work photos and a monthly report.

source.quote: | **Pro**, optional | £10 a month or £100 a year, through Stripe, for any listed trader: job requests, alerts, quotes and invoices, review requests, ID check, work photos and a monthly report (`lib/pro-features.ts`). The admin can grant *founding Pro* free for a set time |

facts.text: Sign-in by text message is still switched off, so residents sign in with Google or an email code, and Pro alerts go by email.

source.quote: **Texts**: sign-in by text and Pro's text alerts need Twilio (see *Phone sign-in*). Until then sign-in is Google or an email code, and alerts go by email.

source.quote: then remove the *Draft — pending legal review* banner

facts.text: Bolton Vouched is at https://www.boltonvouched.co.uk.

source.quote: | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | `https://www.boltonvouched.co.uk`.

facts.text: Pro traders can send quotes and invoices as links; the customer accepts a quote online and the invoice carries the trader's bank details.

source.quote: **quotes and invoices** sent as links (`/d/<token>`; the customer accepts a quote online, the invoice carries the trader's bank details)

facts.text: Pro is offered, never pushed: it appears on the For traders page and the dashboard, and nobody is chased to upgrade.

source.quote: **Pro is offered, never pushed.** It's on the For traders page and the dashboard; nobody is chased to upgrade.

facts.text: The basic listing is free forever, and nobody is removed, hidden or moved down for not paying.

source.quote: **The basic listing is free forever.** Nobody is removed, hidden or moved down for not paying.

facts.text: Category lists rank any trader with three or more reviews by their quality score, and profiles can filter reviews by Verified job and Group member.

source.quote: Profiles list them with Verified job and Group member filters, and the category list ranks anyone with three or more by their quality score.

facts.text: Traders can request a listing on the Get listed page without creating an account.

source.quote: (`/get-listed`) still takes a request without an account

facts.text: A trader can sign in, fill in one form and their listing goes live straight away.

source.quote: listing goes **live straight away**, linked to their account.

facts.text: Traders get their own review link, a QR card and a 'Vouched in Bolton' badge for their website.

source.quote: their review link and QR card, **Put it on Google** (their page link for the Website box of a Google Business Profile, tagged `?utm_source=google_business`), and their "Vouched in Bolton" website badge.

facts.text: The directory can be installed to a phone's Home Screen as an app.

source.quote: installs to the Home Screen as an app

facts.text: Traders' numbers are never in the page's HTML, and one connection can open at most 60 numbers an hour.

source.quote: **The numbers are never in the page's HTML**, and one connection can open at most 60 an hour.

facts.text: Repeated taps from the same connection on the same day count as one enquiry, so the enquiry count is hard to inflate for or against anyone.

source.quote: **One enquiry per connection per day.** Ten taps from the same connection on the same day count once

facts.text: Ask Bolton recommendations never touch ranking, scores or badges.

source.quote: Recommendations never touch ranking, scores or badges.

facts.text: Data is held in London in its own Supabase project that shares nothing with any other project.

source.quote: London. Its own project, sharing **nothing** (keys, users, database, storage) with any other project.
